title: The boy at the fence
logline: A boy of fourteen at the mill's chain-link fence in 1994, from behind, fingers through the wire, watching the yard. Which boy the page doesn't say. The group photo has him at its edge; this is where he stood before it.

panels.composition: From behind: a thin boy in a too-big jacket at a chain-link fence with his fingers through the wire, the mill yard beyond with its log decks and stack, a dog's shadow beside him that no dog casts. Era I spotting.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, in the Era I manner, heavy black spotting brought back on purpose, seen from behind, a thin boy in an oversized jacket with his fingers hooked through a chain-link fence watching a mill yard with log decks and a smoking stack beyond, no words
image.notes: Which boy: reserved. No character id on purpose; a dog's shadow with no dog.

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: A boy at the fence. Not identified.
